meaning:
1) to look at or to, regard, gaze at or about
1a) (Qal) to gaze at, regard, behold, look about
1b) (Hiphil) to look away, cause gaze to turn away
1c) (Hithpael) to look in dismay, gaze about (in anxiety)

renderings.bsb: that we may look on together in dismay

elsewhere.note: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. Yahweh respected Abel and his offering,
Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”
They looked, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
